titlStmt.titl: GAAIS – General Attitudes towards Artificial Intelligence Scale

citation.biblCit: Schepman, A., & Rodway, P. (2023). The General Attitudes towards Artificial Intelligence Scale (GAAIS): Confirmatory validation and associations with personality, corporate distrust, and general trust. International Journal of Human–Computer Interaction, 39(13), 2724–2741. https://doi.org/10.1080/10447318.2022.2085400 — initial validation: Schepman, A., & Rodway, P. (2020). Computers in Human Behavior Reports, 1, 100014. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.chbr.2020.100014

stdyInfo.abstract: 20-item scale of general attitudes towards artificial intelligence with two subscales: positive attitudes (12 items: societal and personal utility, positive emotions) and negative attitudes (8 items: concerns, negative emotions). Validated with UK adults; five-point agreement scale. The negative items are reverse-scored; no overall score is formed.
